description:
Create a new User in the specified Company.

#### Uploading avatar
To upload avatar you must upload whole payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `user[avatar]` as file.

#### Country and State codes
The `country_code` and `state_code` parameter values must conform to the ISO-3166 Alpha-2 specification.
See [Working with Country Codes](/documentation/country-codes) for additional information.

parameters.name: run_configurable_validations
parameters.description: If true, validations are run for the corresponding Configurable Field Set.

contact_id.description: ID of the user's Contact record in this company. Distinct from `id`, which is the login ID.

erp_integrated_accountant.description: Whether the user can push data to the integrated ERP system.

is_active.description: Whether the user is active in the company directory.

is_employee.description: Whether the user is marked as an employee of the company.

last_activated_at.description: Timestamp when the user was most recently activated in the company directory.

welcome_email_sent_at.description: Timestamp when the welcome email was sent to the user. Null if no welcome email has been sent.

party_id.description: The Directory Party ID for this user, resolved via Contact → Person → Party. Null when the user has no associated person record.

permission_template.description: Permission Template assigned to the user by default on new projects. Null when no default template is assigned.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Permission Template

name.description: The name of the Permission Template

project_specific.description: If the Permission Template is project specific

type.description: The type of the Permission Template

category.description: Audience the Permission Template applies to.

company_permission_template.description: Company-level Permission Template assigned to the user. Null when no company template is assigned.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Permission Template

name.description: The name of the Permission Template

project_specific.description: If the Permission Template is project specific

type.description: The type of the Permission Template

category.description: Audience the Permission Template applies to.

vendor.description: Vendor company the user belongs to. Null when the user is not associated with a vendor.

first_name.description: The First Name of the Company User

last_name.description: The Last Name of the Company User

job_title.description: The Job Title of the Company User

address.description: The Address of the Company User

city.description: The City of the Company User

zip.description: The Zip code of the Company User

business_phone.description: The Business Phone of the Company User

business_phone_extension.description: The Business Phone Extension of the Company User

mobile_phone.description: The Mobile Phone of the Company User

fax_number.description: The Fax Number of the Company User

email_address.description: The Email Address of the Company User. Update requests including this parameter will be rejected unless the requesting user has Directory Admin permissions

email_signature.description: The Email Signature of the Company User

is_active.description: The Active status of the Company User

is_employee.description: The Employee status of the Company User

employee_id.description: The ID of the Employee of the Company User when `user[is_employee]` is set to `true`

notes.description: The Notes (notes, keywords, tags) of the Company User

country_code.description: The Country Code of the Company User (ISO-3166 Alpha-2 format)

state_code.description: The State Code of the Company User (ISO-3166 Alpha-2 format)

initials.description: The Initials of the Company User

origin_id.description: The Origin ID of the Company User

origin_data.description: The Origin Data of the Company User

vendor_id.description: The ID of the Vendor of the Company User

default_permission_template_id.description: The ID of the default Permission Template for the Company User. Requests including this parameter will be rejected unless the requesting user has Directory Admin permissions

company_permission_template_id.description: The ID of the Company Permission Template for the Company User. Requests including this parameter will be rejected unless the requesting user has Directory Admin permissions

work_classification_id.description: The ID of the Work Classification for the Company User

avatar.description:
The Avatar of the Company User.
To upload avatar you must upload whole payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `user[avatar]` as file.
